title: Computational De Novo Design of Miniprotein Candidate Neutralizers Targeting the IL-23 Cytokine Subunit p19
abstract: arXiv:2610.32779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interleukin-23 (IL-23) drives T-helper-17 inflammation underlying inflammatory bowel disease and psoriasis; anti-p19 antibodies are clinically effective but large, costly, and injectable. De novo miniproteins are an attractive alternative, yet published designs target the IL-23 receptor; the IL-23 cytokine itself has not been addressed. A further obstacle is that the standard confidence score (ipTM) tracks construct length rather than interface quality. We computationally design miniprotein binders against the IL-23R-binding face of p19 (PDB 3DUH) and score every design with ipSAE, a length-robust interface metric derived from AlphaFold-initial-guess predicted aligned error. A conventional RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN/ColabFold pipeline yields no reliable predicted interface across 972 designs (best ipSAE 0.30), and a scoring artifact, in which single-sequence ColabFold under-rates binder pLDDT by approximately 56 points, explains an earlie

translated_title: 靶向IL-23细胞因子亚基p19的微小蛋白候选中和剂的计算从头设计
translated_abstract: 白细胞介素-23（IL-23）驱动辅助性T细胞17（Th17）型炎症，是炎症性肠病和银屑病的病理基础；抗p19抗体在临床上有效，但分子量大、成本高且需注射给药。从头设计的微小蛋白是一种有吸引力的替代方案，然而已发表的设计均靶向IL-23受体，而IL-23细胞因子本身尚未被涉及。另一个障碍是标准置信度评分（ipTM）反映的是构建体长度而非界面质量。我们通过计算设计针对p19的IL-23R结合面（PDB 3DUH）的微小蛋白结合剂，并使用ipSAE对所有设计进行评分——ipSAE是一种由AlphaFold-initial-guess预测对齐误差衍生的、对长度稳健的界面评分指标。传统的RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN/ColabFold流程在972个设计中未能产生可靠的预测界面（最佳ipSAE仅为0.30），而一种评分假象——即单序列ColabFold会将结合剂的pLDDT低估约56分——解释了先前的……
tldr: 该研究通过计算从头设计靶向IL-23细胞因子p19亚基的微小蛋白候选中和剂，并引入对长度稳健的ipSAE界面评分指标，发现传统设计流程无法产生可靠的预测界面，同时揭示了单序列ColabFold会将结合剂pLDDT低估约56分的评分假象。
